build_BEiTV2Neck_base: build a BEiTV2Neck module with base architecture and 2 patch aggregation layers for pre-training
build_BEiTV2Neck_large: build a BEiTV2Neck module with large architecture and custom drop path rate for pre-training
review_BEiTV2Neck_forward: review the BEiTV2Neck forward method that concatenates cls token with early patch tokens and applies patch aggregation
review_rescale_patch_aggregation_init_we: review the rescale_patch_aggregation_init_weight method that divides attention and FFN weights by sqrt of layer id
test_BEiTV2Neck_arch_zoo: test the BEiTV2Neck arch_zoo dictionary to verify base and large architecture settings are correctly defined
